verses.english: “For insight into greed, eight things should be developed.

verses.pali: Ajjhattaṁ rūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni,
verses.english: Perceiving form internally, they see forms externally, limited, both pretty and ugly.
Mastering them, they perceive: ‘I know and see.’

verses.pali: Ajjhattaṁ rūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya ‘jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṁsaññī hoti.
verses.english: Perceiving form internally, they see forms externally, limitless, both pretty and ugly. …

verses.pali: Ajjhattaṁ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya ‘jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṁsaññī hoti.
verses.english: Not perceiving form internally, they see forms externally, limited, both pretty and ugly. …

verses.pali: Ajjhattaṁ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya ‘jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṁsaññī hoti.
verses.english: Not perceiving form internally, they see forms externally, limitless, both pretty and ugly. …

verses.pali: Ajjhattaṁ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni nīlanibhāsāni
verses.english: Not perceiving form internally, they see forms externally, blue, with blue color and blue appearance. …
Not perceiving form internally, they see forms externally, white, with white color and white appearance.
Mastering them, they perceive: ‘I know and see.’

verses.pali: rāgassa, bhikkhave, abhiññāya ime aṭṭha dhammā bhāvetabbā”.
verses.english: For insight into greed, these eight things should be developed.”
